'''August 2000 Minneapolis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 22 August 2000. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1158">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 25 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-25-minneapolis-minnesota-8-22-00d1158/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 22 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
